context.title: Rollups explained

blocks.text: A rollup executes transactions off chain and posts compressed data to Ethereum, so it inherits Ethereum security while fees are lower.
Optimistic rollups assume transactions are valid and allow a challenge window of seven days. Zero-knowledge rollups post a validity proof with every batch.
The sequencer orders transactions. Today most rollups run a single sequencer.

context.selection: allow a challenge window of seven days
